basic_info.description: Great Fixer Upper on top of Golden Gate Heights Semi-detached, got reverse floor plan with ocean view. Upstairs features living room with wood burning fireplace, formal dining room with ocean view, 3 separated bedrooms & 1 bath. Downstairs offers a family room, bedroom & bath. Lots of potential. Golden Gate Heights Park and Tennis Court within walking distance. Motivated out of town Sellers. Priced for a quick sale. Currently tenants occupied.
